headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 12, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies suffered a blowout loss to the Detroit Tigers, while the New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals. The Kansas City Royals fell to the Baltimore Orioles, and the Chicago Cubs were shut out by the Cincinnati Reds. The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a thrilling comeback against the Milwaukee Brewers, and also secured a 3-2 victory in a separate matchup.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Mike Yastrzemski, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Atlanta Braves due to left elbow inflammation. The Minnesota Twins have also made several roster moves, transferring Anthony Banda to the 60-day injured list and placing Mick Abel on the same list due to right elbow inflammation. The Athletics have placed Nick Kurtz on the 10-day injured list with a right thumb capsule sprain, while the Pittsburgh Pirates have transferred Konnor Griffin to the 60-day injured list. The Milwaukee Brewers have placed Kyle Harrison on the 15-day injured list, and the San Francisco Giants have placed Victor Bericoto on the 10-day injured list.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including a deal between the Chicago White Sox and the Pittsburgh Pirates, which saw the White Sox trade LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pirates for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Minnesota Twins acquired RHP Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations. The New York Mets also made a trade, acquiring RHP Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers for cash.

top_news.title: **Phillies Fall to Tigers in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies suffered a 10-2 loss to the Detroit Tigers, with the Tigers dominating the game from start to finish. Derek Hill led the Tigers' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Nationals 5-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with James Wood leading the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals suffered a 3-5 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, marking their defeat in the matchup. Samuel Basallo led the Royals' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall to Reds in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs suffered a 0-4 loss to the Cincinnati Reds, marking their final score in the game. JJ Bleday led the Cubs' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling Comeback**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6 in a closely contested matchup. Braxton Ashcraft and a strong bullpen performance helped secure the win for the Pirates.

top_news.title: **Pirates Edge Brewers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 3-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Joey Ortiz and Bryan Reynolds leading the charge for the Pirates. Shane Drohan and Bubba Chandler were key contributors for the Pirates, while Brandon Lowe had a notable performance for the Brewers.

top_news.title: **Braves Place Mike Yastrzemski on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Atlanta Braves left fielder Mike Yastrzemski has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation. The move was made on July 11, 2026.

top_news.title: **White Sox Make Midseason Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates on July 11, 2026, in exchange for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations.
